rights_decision.scope_match: All 18 exact manifest image-service IDs/native dimensions and all 159 source tile URLs match the licence-bearing canvases.
rights_decision.contrary_evidence: Generic BL terms prohibit database creation/recirculation absent express permission and recognize more specific service/licence terms. EAP tooling availability alone supplies no publication right. The exact item CC BY-NC grant is affirmative and controls the stated noncommercial use; commercial requests and modern wrapper rights remain separate.
rights_decision.actual_attribution: ZIP ATTRIBUTION.txt and PDF page19 preserve holder/digitizer/provider/funder, source/licence links, required statement, technical changes, noncommercial limitation, project CC BY carveout, no endorsement and disclaimer. Independent rights and technical reviews accepted these exact bytes.
rights_decision.platform_terms_limit: The acquired GitHub Agreement's A.14 excludes underlying content created by others from Your Content; D.3 requires third-party licence compliance. Its broader D.4 service grant therefore does not authorize this project to relicense EAP images into commercial reuse or its own CC BY offer. This remains a bounded assessment for the stated noncommercial research distribution, not a finding that every free/public repository is noncommercial.

independent_review.pdf_and_zip: All 159 JPEGs recovered byte-identically by pdfimages; native MediaBoxes, drawing matrices, stream lengths and page19 word bounds passed. All 187 member hashes/disclosure and a network-free bit-identical offline rebuild passed.

scope_limits: Offered digital sequence completeness is established; physical-volume and intact-text completeness are not.
Damage/repairs obscure source areas. Page 6 and 13 number assignments are positional; the blank after 19 is not visibly numbered 20. No exterior rear-cover image is offered.
No qualified Armenian transcription, word-level collation, whole-book textual equivalence, recension/stage promotion or historical ancestry is established.
This review is the project's bounded source/retention assessment, not an ecclesiastical approval or a commercial-use licence.
semantics: Project-created acquisition, integrity, rights and retention metadata for one distinct bibliographic witness. All offered source frames were acquired; this review does not establish physical-volume completeness, qualified Armenian text, a native-text stage, recension or historical ancestry.
